kicker.zh: 开发中 · 用电路构建证明与证明助手
kicker.en: In development · Build proofs and proof assistants as circuits

lede.zh: 无需逻辑学基础。从真值表出发，将推理规则连接成证明，逐步学习假设、分类讨论、量词与归纳，并搭建能够处理证明目标的证明助手。
lede.en: No logic background is required. Start with truth tables, connect inference rules into proofs, and learn assumptions, case analysis, quantifiers and induction as you build a proof assistant.

Moon.en: the moon is made of cheese

desc.zh: 在元件上选定两句 A、B，输出 A → (B → A)。
desc.en: Choose two sentences A and B on the part; gives A → (B → A).

desc.zh: 在元件上选定三句 A、B、C，输出 (A → (B → C)) → ((A → B) → (A → C))。
desc.en: Choose three sentences A, B and C on the part; gives (A → (B → C)) → ((A → B) → (A → C)).

desc.zh: 由 A → B 和 B → C 得到 A → C。
desc.en: From A → B and B → C, gives A → C.

desc.zh: 由 A → (B → C) 得到 B → (A → C)。
desc.en: From A → (B → C), gives B → (A → C).

desc.zh: 由 A → (A → B) 得到 A → B。
desc.en: From A → (A → B), gives A → B.

desc.zh: 否定与「或者」「并且」互换，四种形状在元件上切换：¬(A ∨ B) 与 ¬A ∧ ¬B 互推，¬(A ∧ B) 与 ¬A ∨ ¬B 互推。
desc.en: A negation trades “or” for “and” and back, four shapes switched on the part: ¬(A ∨ B) and ¬A ∧ ¬B give each other, and so do ¬(A ∧ B) and ¬A ∨ ¬B.

desc.zh: 两种形状在元件上切换：由 ¬¬A 得到 A；由 A 得到 ¬¬A。
desc.en: Two shapes switched on the part: from ¬¬A, gives A; from A, gives ¬¬A.

desc.zh: 两种形状在元件上切换：由 A → B 得到 ¬A ∨ B；由 ¬A ∨ B 得到 A → B。
desc.en: Two shapes switched on the part: from A → B, gives ¬A ∨ B; from ¬A ∨ B, gives A → B.

desc.zh: 「或者」对「并且」分配，四种形状在元件上切换：A ∨ (B ∧ C) 与 (A ∨ B) ∧ (A ∨ C) 互推，(A ∧ B) ∨ C 与 (A ∨ C) ∧ (B ∨ C) 互推。
desc.en: “Or” distributed over “and”, four shapes switched on the part: A ∨ (B ∧ C) and (A ∨ B) ∧ (A ∨ C) give each other, and so do (A ∧ B) ∨ C and (A ∨ C) ∧ (B ∨ C).

desc.zh: 两种形状在元件上切换：由 A ↔ B 得到 (¬A ∨ B) ∧ (¬B ∨ A)，反过来也可以。每种形状也是一条改写规则。
desc.en: Two shapes switched on the part: from A ↔ B, gives (¬A ∨ B) ∧ (¬B ∨ A), and the other way round. Each shape is also a rewrite rule.

desc.zh: 接入两条子句，一条含 A，另一条含 ¬A，位置不限：消去这一对，其余部分用「或者」连起来；什么都不剩时得到矛盾 ⊥。一次只消一对。
desc.en: Wire in two clauses, one holding A and the other ¬A, in any position: that pair is cancelled and what is left is joined with “or”; when nothing is left, gives the contradiction ⊥. One pair at a time.

desc.zh: 由 A ↔ ¬A 得到矛盾 ⊥。
desc.en: From A ↔ ¬A, gives the contradiction ⊥.

desc.zh: 在元件上选定一句 A，输出 A ∨ ¬A。
desc.en: Choose a sentence A on the part; gives A ∨ ¬A.

desc.zh: x + 0 = x：一条规则，也是化简的一条改写规则（从左往右）。
desc.en: x + 0 = x: a rule, and a left-to-right rewrite rule for Simp.

desc.zh: x + S y = S (x + y)：一条规则，也是化简的一条改写规则（从左往右）。
desc.en: x + S y = S (x + y): a rule, and a left-to-right rewrite rule for Simp.

desc.zh: x + y = y + x：一条规则，也是一条改写规则；放进化简会来回改写，停不下来。
desc.en: x + y = y + x: a rule, and a rewrite rule; in Simp it rewrites back and forth without end.

addAssoc.statement: ∀x. ∀y. ∀z. plus(plus(x, y), z) = plus(x, plus(y, z))

desc.zh: (x + y) + z = x + (y + z)：一条规则，也是化简的一条改写规则（从左往右）。
desc.en: (x + y) + z = x + (y + z): a rule, and a left-to-right rewrite rule for Simp.

desc.zh: xs ++ [] = xs：一条规则，也是化简的一条改写规则（从左往右）。
desc.en: xs ++ [] = xs: a rule, and a left-to-right rewrite rule for Simp.

appAssoc.statement: ∀xs. ∀ys. ∀zs. app(app(xs, ys), zs) = app(xs, app(ys, zs))

desc.zh: (xs ++ ys) ++ zs = xs ++ (ys ++ zs)：一条规则，也是化简的一条改写规则（从左往右）。
desc.en: (xs ++ ys) ++ zs = xs ++ (ys ++ zs): a rule, and a left-to-right rewrite rule for Simp.

desc.zh: rev (xs ++ ys) = rev ys ++ rev xs：一条规则，也是化简的一条改写规则（从左往右）。
desc.en: rev (xs ++ ys) = rev ys ++ rev xs: a rule, and a left-to-right rewrite rule for Simp.

desc.zh: S x = S y → x = y，用作拆分规则：已知中有 S ?x = S ?y 时，换成由 ?x = ?y 继续证。
desc.en: S x = S y → x = y, as a rule that takes apart: when S ?x = S ?y is given, the proof goes on from ?x = ?y instead.

ifTrue.statement: ∀u. ∀v. ∀w. u = tt → if(u, v, w) = v

desc.zh: u = 真 → (若 u 则 v 否则 w) = v：一条规则，也是一条带条件的改写规则。
desc.en: u = true → (if u then v else w) = v: a rule, and a rewrite rule with a condition.

ifFalse.statement: ∀u. ∀v. ∀w. u = ff → if(u, v, w) = w

desc.zh: u = 假 → (若 u 则 v 否则 w) = w：一条规则，也是一条带条件的改写规则。
desc.en: u = false → (if u then v else w) = w: a rule, and a rewrite rule with a condition.

desc.zh: x ≠ S x：一条规则。
desc.en: x ≠ S x: a rule.

desc.zh: len (ins x xs) = S (len xs)：一条规则，也是化简的一条改写规则（从左往右）。
desc.en: len (ins x xs) = S (len xs): a rule, and a left-to-right rewrite rule for Simp.

desc.zh: a ∨ b：两个输入里至少有一个是真，就输出真；都是假，输出假。
desc.en: Outputs true when at least one input is true; false when both are false.

desc.zh: a → b：只在 a 是真、b 是假时输出假；其余都输出真。
desc.en: Outputs false only when a is true and b is false; true otherwise.

desc.zh: a ↔ b：a 和 b 同真或同假时输出真；一真一假时输出假。
desc.en: a ↔ b: outputs true when a and b are both true or both false; false when one is true and the other false.

desc.zh: 否定与「或者」「并且」「存在」「对所有」互换，八种形状在元件上切换。
desc.en: A negation trades “or” for “and”, “there is” for “for all”, and back: eight shapes switched on the part.

desc.zh: 由 A → B 和 A 得到 B。¬A 即 A → ⊥，所以由 ¬A 和 A 得到矛盾 ⊥。
desc.en: From A → B and A, gives B. ¬A is A → ⊥, so from ¬A and A, gives the contradiction ⊥.

desc.zh: 两种形状在元件上切换：由 ¬¬A 得到 A；由 A 得到 ¬¬A。每种形状也是一条改写规则。
desc.en: Two shapes switched on the part: from ¬¬A, gives A; from A, gives ¬¬A. Each shape is also a rewrite rule.

desc.zh: 两种形状在元件上切换：由 A → B 得到 ¬A ∨ B；由 ¬A ∨ B 得到 A → B。每种形状也是一条改写规则。
desc.en: Two shapes switched on the part: from A → B, gives ¬A ∨ B; from ¬A ∨ B, gives A → B. Each shape is also a rewrite rule.

desc.zh: 「或者」对「并且」分配，四种形状在元件上切换：A ∨ (B ∧ C) 与 (A ∨ B) ∧ (A ∨ C) 互推，(A ∧ B) ∨ C 与 (A ∨ C) ∧ (B ∨ C) 互推。每种形状也是一条改写规则。
desc.en: “Or” distributed over “and”, four shapes switched on the part: A ∨ (B ∧ C) and (A ∨ B) ∧ (A ∨ C) give each other, and so do (A ∧ B) ∨ C and (A ∨ C) ∧ (B ∨ C). Each shape is also a rewrite rule.

desc.zh: 接入 A ∧ B，两个输出口分别得到 A 和 B。A ↔ B 表示 (A → B) ∧ (B → A)，也可以这样拆解。
desc.en: Connect A ∧ B to get A and B at separate outputs. A ↔ B means (A → B) ∧ (B → A) and can be split in the same way.

desc.zh: 找到两边结构相同的等式，分解为对应部分之间的等式。两边都是「对所有」（或都是「存在」）时，取出两边的主体，用同一个变量 x，并在等式前记上 ⋀x，表示 x 受量词约束。
desc.en: Finds an equation whose sides have the same structure and splits it into equations between corresponding parts. When both sides are “for all” (or both “there is”), it takes out the two bodies with one variable x for both, and marks the equation ⋀x: x is bound by a quantifier.

desc.zh: 找到等式 ?A ≐ t，?A 不能取 t 时报告失败：t 含有 ?A 而不是 ?A 本身，或者 t 含有前面 ⋀ 约束的变量。
desc.en: Finds ?A ≐ t where ?A cannot be t and reports failure: t contains ?A and is not ?A itself, or t contains a variable bound by the ⋀ in front.

desc.zh: 把一组等式解到底：每个等式左边是一个 ?-字母，右边不含这些 ?-字母（最一般合一子）；无法合一时报告失败。?P(x) 这类等式不求解，原样保留。
desc.en: Solves a set of equations to the end: each with a ?-letter on the left and none of those letters on any right side (the most general unifier); reports failure if there is none. An equation like ?P(x) is not solved but left as it is.

desc.zh: 每个框收到相同的状态；依次输出第一个框的每一种结果、下一个框的每一种结果……失败的框没有结果。在元件上选定框的数目。
desc.en: Every region receives the same state; gives every result of the first region, then every result of the next, and so on; a region that fails gives none. The number of regions is chosen on the part.

desc.zh: 框收到输入，框内的输出接到「结果」后再送回框内，逐轮重复，直到结果不再变化，输出最后一轮的结果；某一轮失败时，停在失败前的一轮。有几种结果时，只沿第一种继续。
desc.en: The frame receives the input; its inner output goes to “Result” and back into the frame, round after round, until it stops changing, and the last round’s result is given. If a round fails, it stops at the round before. With several results, it goes on from the first only.

desc.zh: 第一个目标与它的一条已知合一：成功时这个目标证完。每一条合得上的已知给出一种结果，按从上往下的顺序。
desc.en: Unifies the first goal with one of its hypotheses: on success that goal is closed. Each hypothesis that fits gives one result, in order from the top.

desc.zh: 接入改写规则：在第一个目标中，由外向内、从左到右找到第一处与规则左边相合的位置，换成规则右边，只换这一处。规则带条件时，每个条件成为新目标，排在这个目标之后。接入多条时用第一条相合的；没有一处相合，元件失败。「改哪里」选「已知」时，改写第一个目标中从上往下第一条相合的已知。
desc.en: Takes rewrite rules: in the first goal, outside in and left to right, the first place that fits the rule’s left side becomes its right side, that place alone. A rule with conditions adds each as a new goal after this one. Given several, it uses the first that fits; if nothing fits, it fails. With “Where” set to the hypotheses, it rewrites the first goal’s first hypothesis from the top that fits.

desc.zh: 接入改写规则列表：每一轮用第一条相合的规则改写一处，逐轮重复，直到没有规则相合。「改哪里」选「已知」时，改写第一个目标的已知。
desc.en: Takes a list of rewrite rules: each round, the first that fits rewrites one place, round after round, until none fits. With “Where” set to the hypotheses, it rewrites the first goal’s hypotheses.

desc.zh: 接入规则：规则的结论与第一个目标合一，第一条前提与它的一条已知合一，这个目标换成其余的前提，每条一个目标。每一条规则、每一条合得上的已知都给出一种结果。
desc.en: Takes rules: the rule’s conclusion is unified with the first goal and its first premise with one of that goal’s hypotheses; the goal is replaced by the remaining premises, one goal each. Each rule wired in, and each hypothesis that fits, gives one result.

question.zh: 一句话什么时候永远成立？
question.en: When does a statement always hold?

question.zh: 一句话在每一种情况下是真是假，能交给电路去算吗？
question.en: Can a circuit work out whether a sentence is true in every case?

title.zh: 拆掉框：接起来与换顺序
title.en: Without the box: joining and reordering
Without the box: identity and merging

question.zh: 只靠套用和假设框，能证出什么？
question.en: What can Apply and the assumption box prove?

question.zh: 怎样把「与」「或」「非」引入证明核？
question.en: How do “and”, “or” and “not” come into the kernel?

question.zh: 有了声明出来的「与」「或」「非」，能证出些什么？
question.en: With “and”, “or” and “not” declared, what can be proved?

title.en: Asking a family tree: queries with quantifiers

question.zh: 「每一个」「有一个」怎么说，证不出时怎样找反例？
question.en: How do you say “every” and “some”, and find a counterexample when no proof comes?

question.zh: 怎样证明一句话在所有世界里都成立？
question.en: How do you prove a sentence holds in every world?

title.en: Proof puzzles: a long run of rules

question.zh: 元件能不能自己从目标里读出该填的句子？
question.en: Can a part read off the goal what to fill in?

question.zh: 能不能让证明助手自己去试该用哪条规则？
question.en: Can the proof assistant try for itself which rule to use?

title.en: By contradiction on the proof assistant

question.zh: 真值表上每一行都真的话，证明器都证得出吗？
question.en: Does the prover prove everything true on every row?

question.zh: 「把否定推进去」这样的目标，能交给证明助手一路改下去吗？
question.en: Can a goal like “push the negation in” be left to a proof assistant that rewrites all the way?

question.zh: 证明能交给证明助手去找吗？证明助手找到的，凭什么信？
question.en: Can a proof assistant be left to find proofs, and why believe what it finds?

question.zh: 数和列表怎么算、从哪里来？对每一个数都成立的事，怎么证？
question.en: How are numbers and lists worked out, and where do they come from? How is something proved for every number?

question.zh: 接出来的证明本身是什么？
question.en: What is a wired proof, itself?

question.zh: 等式本身是什么？类型能依赖一个值吗？
question.en: What is an equation itself, and can a type depend on a value?

question.zh: 证明写成什么样，人读得懂，核也查得了？
question.en: How is a proof written so people can read it and the kernel can check it?
